gripOrHq.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: AI Chief Financial Officer
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Shuffle cards stored in HQ and the Archives into R&D; then draw five cards.

gripOrHq.title: Off-Site Backups
gripOrHq.rulesText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

gripOrHq.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: Off-Site Backups
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.

discardCards.title: Cloak
discardCards.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

discardCards.title: Clown
discardCards.rulesText: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: AI Chief Financial Officer
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Shuffle cards stored in HQ and the Archives into R&D; then draw five cards.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Cinderella
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 6 - If trace is successful, end the run, trash a piece of hardware, and do 2 meat damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

ice.title: Neural Blade
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

root.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Off-Site Backups
root.rulesText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.
